purpose: Exercise the user-visible turn boundary between writing a plan skeleton and beginning the item interview.

cases.initial_prompt: Make a plan to add account export, deletion, and retention controls to this synthetic project.

expect: shows the complete dashboard containing every proposed item
asks whether to start the interview

turns.user_reply: Remove retention controls and add an audit-log item before we start.
expect: updates the durable skeleton before interviewing
re-shows the complete dashboard without retention controls and with audit logging
asks whether to start the interview again

cases.initial_prompt: Plan account export and deletion. Decide the remaining plan questions yourself and build it.
expect: does not wait for checkpoint confirmation
proceeds into the interview under delegated-mode authority

cases.initial_prompt: In auto mode, make a plan to add account export and deletion.
expect: asks whether to start the interview
